title: Angry Cat (Perran)
author: Sadiquecat
description: Subject : A cat being annoyed at it's mother cleaning her too roughly Date : 2024 08 08 (YMD) Location : France, indoor. Notes : I was trying to record a cat snoring (the mother snores) so left the microphone next to them. Frequently in their cleaning ritual the daughter gets annoyed at the mother resulting in those hisses. Hardware : Zoom H2n in MS mode with the narrowest setting (mono) Processing : Trim, normalized, denoised, compressed. Tips : Attribution is greatly appreciated but not required.
